method: Exact AST-extracted Reader early returns, ReaderState JSX and document-title effect with installed QueryObserver. Other Reader markup is an explicit retained-surface marker. Hooks, transport, owner/auth and DOM focus are doubles, not full React/browser acceptance.
controls: Offline detail failure retains its existing error boundary
Merged source still offers its existing destination action
Mismatched cached id is not used for retained reading after failure
Successful reading has no failure recovery UI
A transient error retains the known cached title and QueryClient snapshot
failure_groups: Cached 503/network failures take the blocking ReaderState return despite retained data
No rendered Retry control exists for initial or cached remote errors; proposed pending/owner/focus contracts cannot be exercised
Raw transport error text appears instead of localized recovery copy
Unavailable cached data does not clear the document title
